content.content: 1. Necessity: the output contract needs the version source for the stamped string it constrains — without it, line shape plus build identity is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Output is where the elaboration meets the source; the gate keeps the use sound without testing invocation itself.
